items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: because his sister Diane plays violin.

ctx.x: . . . because his sister Diane plays violin.

Yeah, cello, right. But she tuned the piano every set, the day we were recording, after – whoa, okay. But when you – still, when you listen to it, it was just – but again, it was one of those records that the energy of it – it was a very popular record.
